comparison_universe: Chapters1-66, canonical catalog, two sound workshops,62-64 and65-66 association second-look supplements. Exact term/root and actual cue-ingredient searches saved in laneA. No concurrent69-71 bank references; possible parallel overlap not adjudicated. Association classes are reasoned local comparisons, not corpus-wide novelty or unique library-growth counts.
cue_policy: Familiar category, packaging, action and partial-name bridges allowed with explicit scope. No all-syllable or untrained-unique-name requirement. No unsupported specific subtype or generic topic prop presented as a name cue.
review_status: Independent source/conceptual review and bounded repair rechecks complete; main integrated. Offline untested; not production admitted.
coverage_limits: Native line spans are not exact per-word boxes; line wraps, ligatures and shared heads normalized explicitly. Rasters corroborate layout, not exhaustive clinical coverage.
No visible highlight was identified and annotation arrays were empty; flattened markup or tiny embedded image overlays may escape identification.
Selected scope may omit qualifiers. Taught object/category/sound naming remains uncertain; no clinical currency, recall, rendering, originality or production evidence.

counting_note: Historical new/reused candidate counts are ingredient/reference bookkeeping, NOT new-association or unique-library-growth counts. Association counts are local editorial comparisons and include repeated head families across entries; do not add chapter occurrences into unique growth.
